# Housekeeping: effect-compiler

## Authorized scope and smallest closable slice

Review the complete `crates/effect-compiler` Cargo package and its tests. Deliver practical, behavior-preserving cleanup in this package, or an evidenced no-change verdict when existing choices earn their cost. Cover all five user requests: repeated code/LoC; load-bearing test purposes; avoidable copies; applicable micro SIMD; and data structures that cap efficiency. The user requests two GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh agents concurrently; this overrides the default Terra implementation model for this workflow. Root Sol owns briefing, adversarial review, exact-path checkpoints, integration and remote synchronization.

## Frozen boundaries

Existing public APIs, feature behavior, canonical/wire identities, arithmetic order and per-lane rendered bits, latency/tail, link modes, smoothing and NaN/denormal rules remain contractual. Zero render allocations/frees, locks, I/O or syscalls; no runtime native ISA dispatch. Retain scalar tails, 4-lane Wasm/NEON and x86 AVX2/FMA. Preserve all feature and target configurations. Do not expand another open issue or change DSP algorithms. Read current related issue bodies before touching their subject; discoveries that require architecture or product decisions become bounded follow-ups and final owner questions.

## Implementation and test-value decisions

Prefer deleting or consolidating repetition to adding abstractions that increase total complexity. Assess every existing test or a clearly named homogeneous family by its plausible unique defect; remove trivial, redundant or obsolete cases only after identifying the surviving behavioral gate. Keep independent numeric/oracle, fault, allocation, queue, boundary and target tests. Add/rewrite tests only for a concrete uncovered defect, and state which plausible defect no existing test catches. No prose/source-grep tests, new bit-digest pins or exact resource-byte pins. Copies needed for ownership, snapshots or atomic admission stay unless the same semantics are proved with less work. Data structure changes must preserve deterministic order and bounded realtime work. Inspect applicable hot loops and generated code before claiming additional SIMD; recursive/stateful dependencies alone do not justify changing arithmetic.

## Objective gates and evidence

- Read all production and test files in this package; record concise findings for each of the five requests, concrete changed/deferred locations, and load-bearing test families with retained coverage for deletions.
- Run focused locked package tests and affected feature configurations; use existing downstream/RT/differential gates proportional to the changed contract. Check formatting and package clippy with warnings denied. Relevant Wasm and AArch64 compile checks are required for changed product code; record limitations candidly.
- Changes to DSP arithmetic or hot state need existing independent numeric and scalar/SIMD gates plus one-time base/head evidence when needed; no permanent comparison against the old implementation. Existing research remains the algorithm authority; no new algorithm or listening claim is authorized.
- Benchmarks are optional and descriptive. Any timed measurement freezes its workload/validator, passes zero-workload preflight, and runs exactly one invocation with one warmup/two measured rounds. No timing optimization loop, performance percentage or unsupported sound-quality claim.
- Root conducts one adversarial verdict per coherent attempt, at most five total attempts. Every new/rewritten test gets its unique-defect sentence in that verdict. No-change audits require the same five-axis review, not manufactured edits.
- Stop after a coherent compiling, focused-green tranche; root commits exact owned paths before further edits. Keep edits within `crates/effect-compiler` and this numbered spec. Independent crates use separate worktrees. Root pushes promptly and updates this GitHub issue with evidence; close only after PASS and evidence upstream, verifying remote state. Merge through the required qualification check and remove clean completed worktrees.

## Sol brief approval and decision record

Approved 2026-10-01 by root Sol within the user's crate-by-crate housekeeping request. Attempt 1 is authorized with the frozen scope/gates above. Owner questions are collected for the final report; routine reversible cleanup proceeds autonomously. Scope is this package's housekeeping, not completion of pre-existing feature/bug issues.

## Attempt evidence

### Attempt 1 — worker B, 2026-10-01

Reviewed all four source files, all five integration test files and the manifest. Related #291 lattice redesign, #774 response-binding scope, #338 canonical-session scope and #560 compiler/ownership audit obligations remain separate. Root approved the dependency amendment below before editing and checkpointed the compiling, focused-green implementation as `528e3335` (upstream via `a83359b0`). No later product tranche was added.

**Five-axis findings**

- Repetition/LoC: one matching pass now records the three parameter channel values, duplicate presence and unit validity; it replaces temporary collections plus repeated count/find passes. Unit mismatch still precedes channel refusal, then domain/unknown refusal; descriptor and Left/Right output order remain exact. Ten identical test compile-cap stanzas share one helper. The obsolete EQ factory test wrapper only forwarded the now-enabled production capability, so owner tests use `ParametricEqFactory` directly. Net Rust change **−190 lines (+82/−272)**; one unused manifest dependency and its one amended lockfile line removed.
- Tests: removed one redundant catalog-count test, same-input conversion equality and a hard-coded sweep count; kept actual catalog/decimal/index/ownership laws. Reduced the homogeneous 10,000-value upper-domain loop to three directed values. No test was added; deletion/survivor purposes are below.
- Copies: parameter matching uses a local three-slot array, without owned match/value vectors. Live-control and observation lookup keys borrow normalized IDs; address construction reads console/insert declarations without constructing lowered effects and copying their parameter payloads. The existing owned diagnostic path is reused on owner failure. Committed/candidate rows, prepared request inputs, producer/reader IDs, factory `Arc`s and the caller's compiled-session snapshot remain independently owned because transaction/replay/plan lifetimes require them.
- Micro SIMD: this package performs string/descriptor lookup, validation, resource accounting and ownership transfer on the control plane; it contains no sample-processing kernel or bulk numeric loop to vectorize. Native bank binding and per-lane arithmetic remain with the effect owners. No SIMD, arithmetic, state or dispatch change was justified; 4-lane Wasm/NEON and AVX2/FMA behavior remain qualified by existing owner/target gates.
- Data structures: the live-address `BTreeMap` keeps deterministic `(track, internal rack, effect ID)` ordering while its keys become borrowed strings. Console addresses retain the pre/post split and track-entry bound; insert indices remain declaration positions, independent of prepared-entry sorting. Parameter projection now traverses each matching set once. The allocation-free resource query's prior-owner `Arc::ptr_eq` scan and bounded candidate-row scans stay unchanged; adding another retained index or allocating a temporary set would require separate cost/ownership evidence. No new cap or measured speed claim.

**Test changes and surviving gates**

- `the_launch_catalog_is_not_empty_and_every_row_is_swept` → `launch_registry_prepares_the_accepted_nine_track_parametric_eq_fixture` still checks all eight named launch factories and real fixture preparation. The remaining law tests enumerate every descriptor's complete parameter slice. The removed 69-row count froze catalog size despite its own comment saying the count was not a contract.
- `every_lattice_point_reaches_the_engine_through_the_one_blessed_conversion` → renamed `catalog_endpoints_and_an_interior_point_round_trip_to_their_indices`. It retains canonical and padded-spelling index checks for both endpoints and a middle point of every row. Comparing two conversions of the identical string after asserting the identical index could not discriminate a defect; `every_shipped_row_declares_a_lawful_lattice` already converts every point, and `the_prepared_word_of_a_default_is_bit_identical_to_the_descriptor` retains the independent descriptor-word oracle. The 207-iteration size pin was removed.
- `ten_thousand_session_parameter_mutations_reject_transactionally_without_panic` → `out_of_domain_session_parameters_reject_transactionally_without_panic`: one ULP above 24, 25 and the largest finite f32 preserve upper-bound, ordinary and extreme refusal/panic coverage. The old 25..10024 values all exercised the same scalar domain-refusal branch. This remains the package's direct domain-refusal gate; unknown-ID, channel and transaction gates defend different errors.
- Owner tests retain all assertions with the actual production factory replacing the pass-through double. The retained resource-formula test uses real capacities/layouts and shared factory identity rather than a frozen internal byte pin. Ladder tests use the already-fixed `StepSize::ALL` array directly instead of a heap vector.

**Retained behavioral families (35 tests)**

- Inline control owner (1): revision overflow refuses before changing candidate/committed/dirty state. Producer endpoint (2): unsupported-target refusal precedes queue/full counters, while ordinary full refusal returns the original record/generation and preserves admitted FIFO contents. Live address (1): pre/post split, insert bounds, empty racks and large indices. Owner (7): actual retained table/backings/shared-factory accounting; Both coalescing and one commit; two queued transactions before render; launch-rate admission; poisoned edits cannot be repaired by overwriting; complete-prefix capacity refusal leaves queue/candidate/counters unchanged; stale revision and premature commit refusal.
- `native_session` (10): all launch factories/fixture preparation, cached metadata and canonical snapshot preservation, absent factory/resource refusal, directed domain refusal, three distinct retired parameter IDs, console eligibility versus insert admission, bankable versus prepared bypass identity, and live lanes seeded from the session bypass.
- `parameter_lattice` (9): lawful sorted/indexed/convertible points on every shipped row; intrinsic bounds/defaults; default f32-word oracle; canonical/padded index round trips; mapping-appropriate stepping; every ladder size; builtin disabled sentinels at all launch rates; stable pan authority; generated cutoff ceiling versus a declared maximum. These distinct law/oracle gates remain independent.
- `observation_identity` (2): exact launch tap roster/vocabulary/cost and semantic minor identity, separately the unchanged state-layout identity. `response_analysis` (1): response capability discovery through the registry, declaration/default/filter-enable shape, actual requested query and a nonprovider. `symmetry_designed_words` (2): actual designed per-channel differences including non-ramped limiter window geometry, plus bank lane isolation and out-of-width refusal.

### Root adversarial review — attempt 1

Root adversarial verdict: PASS. Reviewed the production and test diffs and checked normalized console lowering: borrowed addresses preserve its slot/track zip bound, pre/post split and insert declaration order. The three channel slots reject all duplicates/mixed Both requests before successful values are used; unit mismatch still wins, and Left/Right/default/zero normalization and domain-before-unknown diagnostics remain identical. Ordered maps and independently owned public handles/candidates remain. The obsolete factory supplied exactly the production capability now used by the tests. The manifest/lock deletion matches the amendment. Focused feature/release, strict lint, target, downstream command/PCM gates and the 453-row one-time semantic comparison support the frozen behavior claim; no timing/SIMD claim is added.

Test value: the bounded domain-refusal test catches an inclusive upper-limit error one ULP past 24, ordinary illegal values and extreme finite input causing panic/partial preparation, which other parameter-ID/ownership gates do not reach. The rewritten catalog index test catches endpoint/interior or trailing-zero spelling selecting a different point; the deleted repeated conversion and size count added no independent claim. Existing lawful-point/default-word gates retain conversion coverage. The shared compile helper preserves every prior cap and all ten scenario assertions; replacing the forwarding factory keeps actual capacity/revision/poison/queue ownership defects observable. No owner question remains.
